answer.text: Copy one detail from the lesson and stop once the detail matches one word in the question.

feedback.text: This shows partial recall but not mastery. A standards-aligned response must connect evidence to reasoning, not only repeat one detail.

answer.text: Rank every possible career or pathway equally so the response avoids making a supported decision.

feedback.text: This avoids the decision task. Use the evidence to compare options, state the strongest fit, and explain the tradeoff clearly.
